entries.title: Preserve multi-channel workflow listing semantics
entries.rationale: Accepted as a relay authorization and query-semantics hardening change. Preserve NIP-01 OR behavior, explicit-channel scope before limits, bounded request work, authorized live-subscription shrink behavior, and desktop batching/deduplication.
security_reasons: multi-channel filters affect tenant/channel visibility and SQL limits
authorization and explicit #h scope must be applied before database/Redis work
subscription revocation must not leak events from revoked channels
bounded 128-value batching protects relay request resources

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated relay authorization/query threat review, SQL/count/REQ/HTTP parity tests, subscription revocation tests, dependency screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and relay/desktop gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, relay filter/count/bridge/subscription paths, desktop batching, changed tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
